items.title: Designer Bag Raffle
items.body:
🎁 Win a Designer Bag Valued at $2,000+!
Purchase a $20 ticket for your chance to win a designer bag valued at over $2,000!

We’re selling 1,500 tickets to raise $30,000 to support our Youth Ministries — the future of our church!

🎟️ Drawing: Bingo Night • January 2027

Buy your ticket. Support our youth. You could be the winner!
